target: 1xGX10 + Qwen3.8-27B NVFP4_mixed: move from measured 32K inference worker toward large-project Agent/Coding production qualification
optimization_objective: Maximize useful high-intensity coding/Agent capability without buying hardware before a non-substitutable bottleneck is demonstrated.
assumptions: Current first-party evidence is limited to 32K+256 warm C=1 performance/stability and runtime/hardware gate.
A main large-project coding agent should be evaluated at materially larger working-context bands such as 384K/512K.
Model/variant/runtime/context strategy changes are cheaper interventions than adding hardware and must be checked first.
constraints: Do not treat local AI hardware upgrades as acceleration for cloud-model inference.
Do not use configuration maximums as Actual Context evidence.
Quality and production coding fitness must be measured separately from performance.

dominant_bottlenecks: Pure Prefill/TTFT is unmeasured as an isolated metric and has become a larger share of 32K E2E.
Coding quality/tool-loop/long-session production gates are open.

options.trigger: Current state: no first-party target-context or target-concurrency hard gate has yet demonstrated a non-substitutable hardware bottleneck.
expected_gain: Convert unknowns into measured blocking gates before changing topology
residual_bottleneck: Large-context, coding-quality, concurrency and long-run gates remain open until tested

counterfactual_no_hardware.reason: Software/model/context alternatives have not yet been exhausted at the target large-project workload.

options.trigger: Promote after pure-prefill/TTFT measurement confirms a material controllable bottleneck on the target workload.
expected_gain: Improve repeated Agent tool-loop wall-clock when inference is local
does_not_solve: Cannot solve hard memory/KV capacity limits
residual_bottleneck: Decode, quality, memory/KV, build/test may become dominant after TTFT improves

counterfactual_no_hardware.reason: This is itself a no-new-hardware intervention.

options.trigger: Only promote to ACTION if first-party 384K/512K testing hits a memory/KV blocking gate, or target C=2/4 Agent workload shows sustained QoS degradation that model/runtime/workload changes cannot resolve.
residual_bottleneck: Distributed/runtime support may become the new bottleneck

counterfactual_no_hardware.reason: Target large-context/concurrency evidence and model/runtime substitution checks are not complete.

options.trigger: Promote when end-to-end coding-task data shows AI inference and build/workspace bottlenecks are best served by different hosts.
expected_gain: Keep GX10 focused as AI node
Allow CPU/RAM/NVMe-heavy build/test work on a stronger development host
does_not_solve: Does not automatically improve local model quality
Requires explicit execution placement and remote-control reliability
residual_bottleneck: Network/tool orchestration and recovery become part of production latency

counterfactual_no_hardware.reason: Requires real coding-loop placement measurements before choosing topology.

next_test_plan: 128K → 256K → 384K → 512K Actual Context performance and memory/KV gates
Re-evaluate 2x homogeneous-node trigger only after the relevant blocking gate is measured
changed_because: Decision-system v1 now requires counterfactual no-hardware checks and explicit upgrade triggers.
